title: Hanasato Minori — Smoothies Blended With Feelings〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Chasing The Sparkle Beyond the Blue Sky

rows.Line: Beach

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's move on to our next activity!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (What do we get to do next...?! I'm sure it's gonna be something our viewers will really enjoy like the banana boat activity we just did...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For our next challenge, we'll be...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Smashing watermelons!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Woo...hoo...?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Uh, that seems kinda dull lol.>
<That sounds more like playing than training.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. This exercise is actually pretty tricky and involves three people working together as a team.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Three people working together?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right! I'll start by explaining the rules, so listen carefully!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: One person will be blindfolded while trying to smash the watermelon as per normal.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Another person will be allowed to guide the smasher by tugging them along using their hands and such. However, they won't be allowed to speak!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Guiding the blindfolded person while not being allowed to speak sounds incredibly difficult...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. Not being able to see is already pretty scary, so it might be tough to move in the right direction unless you really trust your guide.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right... I get why teamwork is so important here now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Finally, the third person will act as the messenger who will be allowed to speak, but that's all they'll be able to do. They won't be allowed to guide the others by touching them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, because the guide isn't allowed to speak, the messenger will have to relay information to the smasher?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It sounds like they'll be receiving plenty of support. Won't that make things too easy?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah, you'd think so.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But what if the watermelon's placed 500 meters away?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! 500 meters?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: With a time limit of...three minutes!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's not a lot of time...
And being on the beach makes it just that much harder to cover such a distance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Did you really think that I was gonna make this challenge easy to clear?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I'm sorry for doubting you...>
<I love Airi's smug face.>
<This is impossible, right?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I'll also have you rotate roles, so you'll each get a chance to try all of them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, let's draw straws to decide who's gonna be doing what for our first round!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, our first smasher's gonna be... Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That means I'm going to be blindfolded, yes?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You sound pretty excited about that, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, can you tell?
I really haven't had many chances to smash watermelons throughout my life.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Even when I had the opportunity to do so for a TV program, my manager would always say that I wasn't allowed to be the smasher.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, because your sense of direction's so bad...? How you might get your left from your right confused even if you're given the correct directions...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which means I'm going to have to do a good job of guiding Shizuku around...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
D-Don't worry, Haruka!
I'll do my best to say the right things!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, Minori, I'll be counting on you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (H-Haruka's counting on me...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It took me a bunch of tries to complete the banana boat challenge...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (So, I've gotta produce some good results on my first try for this one!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku, I'll blindfold you after you make your way to the starting line.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay, thank you.
Oh, by the way, where's the smashing stick?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ah, you won't actually be smashing the watermelon since you'll all be rotating roles.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A beach ball that looks like a watermelon will be there instead of the real one. Your goal will simply be to reach it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, what about the actual watermelon?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I have one being chilled right now.
We'll have some of it later once we've finished training.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And it'll taste just that much better if you put a good effort into this activity!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, the person not participating in this activity will be in charge of filming and commentating.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As such, I'll be behind the camera first and doing my best to capture some highlight reels of all of you!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Cool! Looking forward to hearing Airi's colorful commentary!>
<Please be careful not to trip and fall, Shizuku!>
<Do your best, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone! I promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, ready?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm ready!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Shizuku, you're facing the sea.
The camera's this way!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
Thank you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No problem! I'll try to guide you like this, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, let's get started...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ready...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Start!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's do our best, everyone!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! So, let's start by going straight... Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sh-Shizuku, you're going too fast!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She's almost up to running speed! While blindfolded!)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Huh? She's blindfolded, right?>
<How's she able to go so fast?!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Here we go! Some drama straight outta the gates! Shizuku's off like a rocket! While blindfolded no less!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you've gotta be about this quick to get to the watermelon in time! Let's see if she can maintain this speed!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-W-W-Wait for meee!
